newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,000T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,000T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly invited tenders to buy a total of 21,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, traders said on Tuesday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang will buy 10,000 tonnes at basis prices over September futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah Flour will buy the remaining 11,000 tonnes at fixed prices, they said.
Shipment was set for July 5-August 5 to the western port of Inchon.
